novelty.justification: The claim proposes to “deliberately embed a benign, secret ‘canary trait’ into a synthetic dataset” and recover it through a “fully black-box” behavioral test, so its novelty route is a new use and measurement of subliminal trait transfer for data provenance rather than a new account of subliminal learning itself. Searches for “subliminal learning watermark synthetic training data,” “steering vector distillation provenance,” “behavioral watermark hidden trait,” and “black-box training data watermark” identify Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation (2026) as the closest mechanism work and Robust Data Watermarking in Language Models by Injecting Fictitious Knowledge (2025) as the closest application work; behavioral provenance also appears in A Behavioral Fingerprint for Large Language Models: Provenance Tracking via Refusal Vectors (2026), but none of these retrieved works uses deliberately transmitted, semantically unrelated steering directions to mark dataset exposure. The step is therefore a substantive multi-step combination and operationalization of known subliminal transfer, steering vectors, and watermark verification—not merely a changed model or renamed method—but it remains a natural extension of those established ingredients rather than a new core mechanistic relationship.
